nodes.label: Medusa Anti-Xray
nodes.rationale: Plugin designed to detect X-ray users via statistical analysis of mined blocks. Uses ratio of weighted suspicious ore score to total blocks, comparing against natural occurrence rates (~1-2%) to flag anomalous behavior.

nodes.label: Detection System
nodes.rationale: Sliding window (30 min) tracks player mining. Block exposure determines suspicion weight: fully hidden ores score 1.0, cave-exposed ores score 0.25. Minimum 64 blocks required before evaluation to prevent early false flags. Alert fires at ratio >= 8%.

nodes.label: Alert System
nodes.rationale: 60-second cooldown prevents chat spam. Staff permission gate (medusa.staff). Configurable prefix with hex color support. Formatted alert message exposes player, ratio, score, and total block count.
